parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination resource group.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the resource group ID of the Bastionhost instance.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance whose resource group you want to change.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the ID of the Bastionhost instance.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates that the resource is a Bastionhost instance.
